text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks for giving me yesterday off. I really appreciated the break.
choice_data_list: Were you able to get a lot of rest in?
Were you able to get a lot of rest in?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I managed to wrap up all my dorm leader duties and talked to my lovely ponies about their concerns.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I also had a one-on-one race with Hishiama, watched Opera O's solo show, and…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course! Entertaining others and enjoying a good time with them is how I recharge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki's definition of "rest" is very different from mine, but she seems alert and refreshed from her break, and that's all that counts.
